Conteúdo escalado e spam: o que não faze: Scaled content and spam: what not to do
Com IA, publicar mil páginas custa quase: With AI, publishing a thousand pages costs almost nothing. That's exactly why Google targets scaled content: many pages made to manipulate rankings, "no matter how they are created." This lesson shows the shortcuts going around, why each one is a risk, and the right path: the 16-item checklist and a cadence that fits within human review.
